title: AI Coloring Page Generator
summary: Free AI coloring page generator: describe an idea or upload a photo and get clean, printable black and white coloring pages for kids and adults in seconds.
body_markdown:
### Can AI make coloring pages?


Yes. An AI image model can draw a coloring page from a short description when you ask for black outlines on white, closed shapes and no shading, which gives a page you can print and colour by hand straight away.


### Is there a free AI coloring page generator?


Yes. Flick is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6, which made the pages here, costs 5 credits an image at its default settings.


### How do I make a coloring page from a photo?


Add the photo as a reference image and ask for a coloring book page of the same subject in clean black line art, with closed shapes, no shading and a simplified background; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### How do I make coloring pages for adults?


Ask for an adult coloring book page with fine, crisp lines, lots of small detail and many small closed spaces, such as a mandala, a garden or a city street, and keep no shading and no solid black so every space can be filled.


### How do I make coloring pages for toddlers?


Ask for one simple subject with extra thick outlines, a handful of very large shapes and lots of white space, because young children colour with big movements and cannot stay inside small areas.


### Can I print AI coloring pages?


Yes. Download the image and print it on plain paper; asking for a white margin and no border keeps the drawing clear of the printer's edge, and a higher resolution setting gives sharper lines on a full page.


### Can I make a whole coloring book with AI?


Yes. Write one prompt per page and keep the same line weight and characters across them, using the first page as a reference image for the rest, so the pages look like they belong to one book.
